items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Romain Rolland wrote a book called Jean- Christophe. Did you ever read it or hear of it?

ctx.x: This is October the 7th [1992], and this is day . . . the first of two days’ interviews with Artie Shaw.
Are we o.k.? [recording engineer:] Yeah, we got a great level.

Before we get into this, or maybe as a way of getting into it, I showed you this material on the book I’ve been working on on-and-off since about 1978. What is it now? This is . . . It’s been 12 years. I’ve published another book in between. I’ve done some CDs. I’ve done a lot of other stuff. But this one . . . I’ll tell you the point of it. I wanted to do a trilogy. I had at one time . . . I don’t know. You’re a reader, so you may know the book. Most people don’t even know of it. Romain Rolland wrote a book…
